prayerExcerpt.en-US: Grant that we may rejoice in peace in this present life, and find help for life eternal.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Concedei-nos, por sua intercessão, a paz neste mundo e a graça de chegar à vida eterna.

meta.face: A man of about forty-five, clean-shaven, with a short, wide, rounded face and ruddy apple cheeks — a short, straight nose, large, round blue-grey eyes under light, arched brows, a small, neat chin and a bow-shaped mouth; light-brown hair showing under the mitre, and a gentle smile turned down toward the boy.
meta.basis: Western images always give him episcopal dress, most often with the candle the widow brought him (Golden Legend), and Memling's Lübeck panel shows a mild, clean-shaven, middle-aged bishop. The younger, ruddy face and light-brown hair are an artistic choice to keep him apart from the other mitred bishops; the smile comes from the Golden Legend.
